Need carefully satisfy behavior. Let's parse requirements.

FB_Task inputs LowWet, HighWet, Inhibit BOOL; outputs Fill, SensorFault BOOL. Retained state qFill BOOL initial false. Need also first? Atomic propositions mention first true only first invocation after reset. LTL P5 first -> !qFill. But qFill initialized false enough. Maybe no first variable needed. Need implement combinational SensorFault = HighWet AND NOT LowWet. Fill behavior:
- If SensorFault or Inhibit or HighWet -> Fill FALSE
- Else if !LowWet & !HighWet & !Inhibit -> Fill TRUE
- Else if middle (LowWet & !HighWet) & !Inhibit -> Fill = qFill (retain)
Need handle LowWet true HighWet false middle retain. LowWet false HighWet false low starts true. LowWet true HighWet true high stops false. LowWet false HighWet true fault false. What about LowWet true HighWet false Inhibit true: forced false. When clearing Inhibit at middle level, retain resulting stopped state? Let's examine test fault_inhibit step 4 LowWet true HighWet false Inhibit true expected Fill false. Step 5 Inhibit false same middle expected Fill false. If implement qFill updated each scan to Fill output, after step4 qFill=false, step5 middle retains false. Good.
But scenario "Clearing Inhibit at a middle level retains the resulting stopped state until water falls below the low switch." means if inhibit forced false, q state becomes false, clearing retains false. Good.

Need qFill retained pre-state. At each scan compute new Fill based on qFill. Then assign qFill := Fill at end? But if qFill is retained Fill pre-scan, update state q[k+1]=Fill[k]. So yes.

Need output SensorFault combinational. Use local variables maybe qFill : BOOL := FALSE; But CODESYS FB VAR could have qFill : BOOL := FALSE; no RETAIN? "retained" semantic but initial. VAR maybe. Need declaration with FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task then all VAR sections. Could use VAR_INPUT, VAR_OUTPUT, VAR. Omit END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Need exact names/types.

Implementation ST body:
SensorFault := HighWet AND NOT LowWet;

IF SensorFault OR Inhibit OR HighWet THEN
    Fill := FALSE;
ELSIF NOT LowWet AND NOT HighWet THEN
    // !Inhibit already false, but include
    Fill := TRUE;
ELSIF LowWet AND NOT HighWet AND NOT Inhibit THEN
    Fill := qFill;
ELSE
    Fill := FALSE;
END_IF;
qFill := Fill;

Need consider logic for LowWet false HighWet false Inhibit true: first IF true due Inhibit => Fill false. Good.
What about LowWet true HighWet false Inhibit false middle: first false, second false, third true => qFill. Good.
What about LowWet false HighWet true SensorFault true => false.
What about LowWet true HighWet true first true HighWet => false. SensorFault false.
What about LowWet false HighWet false Inhibit false: second true => Fill true even if qFill false. Good.
What about LowWet false HighWet false Inhibit false but q? always true. Good.

Potential issue P2 says (SensorFault | Inhibit | HighWet) -> !Fill. Our first IF covers. P3 !LowWet & !HighWet & !Inhibit -> Fill. Our second covers after first? If !LowWet & !HighWet & !Inhibit, SensorFault false, HighWet false, Inhibit false so first false. yes Fill true. P4 middle & !Inhibit -> Fill <-> qFill. Our third gives Fill=qFill. But note if qFill maybe previous. Good.

Need ensure if HighWet true and LowWet true middle? No middle false. Fill false.

Need no supporting objects: [].

But need maybe declaration includes method? no.

Need output JSON only. Valid JSON string escaping newlines. We can include declaration as string with newlines. JSON object with keys. "supporting_objects": [].

Need decide if qFill variable in VAR section. Declaration:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task
VAR_INPUT
    LowWet : BOOL;
    HighWet : BOOL;
    Inhibit : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Fill : BOOL;
    SensorFault : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    qFill : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

No END_FUNCTION_BLOCK.

Implementation body string.

Need avoid Markdown. Return JSON.
